message.content: {"verdict":"BALABLU","reason":"NEAR mainnet produced its first block on April 22, 2020, not in 2018."}
message.reasoning_content:
The claim: NEAR mainnet launched in 2018. Rule: FACT if NEAR mainnet produced its first block in 2018. BALABLU if mainnet started in another year.

Evidence says first block was April 22, 2020. Well-established knowledge: NEAR Protocol mainnet launched in 2020 (Phase 0 "Mainnet Genesis" April 22, 2020). So claim is false → BALABLU.
